choose.when: SELECT t.id, #{type} AS content_type, t.name AS title, t.layer AS summary, t.layer AS searchable_text, CONCAT('/english/vocabulary/', t.id) AS route_path, NULL AS published_at, t.updated_at, NULL AS theme_id FROM sr_english_vocabulary_theme t

SELECT w.id, #{type} AS content_type, w.word AS title, w.translation AS summary, CONCAT_WS(' ', w.part_of_speech, w.scene_meaning, w.inflections, CAST(w.examples AS CHAR)) AS searchable_text, NULL AS route_path, NULL AS published_at, w.updated_at, w.theme_id FROM sr_english_vocabulary_word w INNER JOIN sr_english_vocabulary_theme t ON t.id = w.theme_id

SELECT c.id, #{type} AS content_type, c.title, c.summary, CONCAT_WS(' ', c.subtitle, c.introduction, c.roadmap_markdown) AS searchable_text, '/english/grammar' AS route_path, c.published_at, c.updated_at, NULL AS theme_id FROM sr_english_grammar_course c WHERE c.publish_status = 'PUBLISHED'

SELECT l.id, #{type} AS content_type, l.title, l.summary, l.body_markdown AS searchable_text, CONCAT('/english/grammar/', l.slug) AS route_path, l.published_at, l.updated_at, NULL AS theme_id FROM sr_english_grammar_lesson l INNER JOIN sr_english_grammar_course c ON c.id = l.course_id INNER JOIN sr_english_grammar_section s ON s.id = l.section_id AND s.course_id = c.id WHERE c.publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' AND l.publish_status = 'PUBLISHED'
